image_description: A close-up, side-profile photograph of a wood rabbit (cottontail). The subject is positioned in the lower-left to center frame, facing right. Visible features include large dark eyes, long upright ears with pinkish interiors and dark edges, dense grey-brown fur, and a portion of the snout. The background consists of blurred dry grass and twigs, indicating a shallow depth of field.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the transition between the ear edges and the background. AI models often struggle with thin, semi-translucent structures like rabbit ears against cluttered backgrounds, leading to haloing or fusion. Also, verify if the eye reflection matches the lighting environment implied by the fur highlights.
